takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **64%** of 190 plays (n=122); also Slot 35% (n=67).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **10.2 yd** downfield by the throw (n=189, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (64%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
